replacements.new:
COMPACT_PATH_RE = re.compile(
        r"^/sports/esports/(?P<tournament>\d+)/(?P<event>\d+)/?$",
        re.I,
    )
    # Live esports deep-link used by Fonbet while a match is in progress:
    # /live/esports/81305/67730260
    LIVE_PATH_RE = re.compile(
        r"^/live/esports/(?P<tournament>\d+)/(?P<event>\d+)/?$",
        re.I,
    )
    # Some Fonbet live pages may retain the category/cs segment.
    LIVE_CATEGORY_PATH_RE = re.compile(
        r"^/live/esports/category/cs/(?P<tournament>\d+)/(?P<event>\d+)/?$",
        re.I,
    )

replacements.old:
def parse_event_url(cls, url: str) -> FonbetEventRef:
        parsed = urlparse(url)

replacements.new:
match = (
            cls.CATEGORY_PATH_RE.match(parsed.path)
            or cls.COMPACT_PATH_RE.match(parsed.path)
            or cls.LIVE_PATH_RE.match(parsed.path)
            or cls.LIVE_CATEGORY_PATH_RE.match(parsed.path)
        )
